summary: Implemented all 7 plan phases: corrected rules/error-handling.md to name issue-record.sh as the live error-store write path, added a 16th seed class (infrastructure/transport unavailable) to issue-log.md and issue-record.sh, documented a general tags.occurrence collapse convention and a 10-citation render cap, built scripts/lib/central-log-lib.sh (owning-repo resolution, owning-repo skip, promotion filter, flock-guarded bounded append) wired non-fatally into both issue-record.sh and events-append.sh, and implemented Sapience backend-failure capture as an ordinary subclass (sapience-retrieve.sh's exit-code split, Stage 3.5 capture wiring, and an honest best-effort note for the non-mechanically-capturable MCP-tool class). All four acceptance replays passed against the real deployed scripts (Sapience 503 outage, central promotion with owning-repo skip, occurrence collapse, citation render cap); measured per-call promotion overhead ~17ms. A genuine mid-phase regression (unguarded library source crashing fixtures lacking it) was found via the full test corpus and fixed. Phase 7 closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS against two confirmed pre-existing, unrelated gate findings (a dead-command-recommendation hit in untouched memory-extension docs, and 5 test suites with a pre-existing repo-root path-depth bug) -- both evidenced via git log and direct reproduction in the plan's own Reasoned Exclusions table.
